2 PHYSICAL COMBAT \ R- A
A * Physical attack. I
Your opponent's personalities lose 1 stage.

Name a card. Search your opponent's Life Deck for a
copy of that card and banish it. At the end of combat, you
may choose a non-Event card from your discard pile and

place it on top of your Life Deck.
DAMAGE: 3 life cards.
(Banish after use.) |
